name: io.github.2ez4gcx/sketchup-mcp
title: SketchUp MCP
description: Let AI work in SketchUp: rooms, tagging, real-surface takeoff, checks, scenes, furniture, renders.

environmentVariables.name: SKETCHUP_MCP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: TCP port of the SU MCP Bridge extension in SketchUp (must match the port set in SketchUp)

environmentVariables.name: SKETCHUP_MCP_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Seconds to wait for SketchUp to answer one command

environmentVariables.name: SKETCHUP_MCP_RUN_RUBY
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to leave the run_ruby tool out (it runs arbitrary Ruby code in SketchUp)
